The header still says \"Commits 1\", and /eval/harbor-handbook/commits/branch/agent3-merge-b contains no commit for agent13-counts-a.md. The wrong extra file is still listed after the pull request was merged (rebase then fast-forward). (on /eval/harbor-handbook/pulls/19/files)
bugs.expected: The Files Changed tab shows only the file the pull request adds (agent3-rebase-notes.md), matching its Commits tab (1 commit) and the branch agent3-merge-b, which has no commit touching agent13-counts-a.md. A file that already exists on main and was never touched by the branch must not be listed as changed by the pull request.
bugs.actual: Files Changed says \"2 changed files with 2 additions and 0 deletions\" and lists agent13-counts-a.md as a new file added by this pull request (+1, whole file \"a\"), next to agent3-rebase-notes.md. The header still says \"Commits 1\", and /eval/harbor-handbook/commits/branch/agent3-merge-b contains no commit for agent13-counts-a.md. The wrong extra file is still listed after the pull request was merged (rebase then fast-forward).
reproSteps: Open https://5503-iotjkrbhq2ztebrw6o97y.e2b.app/eval/harbor-handbook/compare/main...agent3-merge-b and click "New Pull Request", then "Create Pull Request" (pull request #19 "Add agent3-rebase-notes.md", one commit adding only the file agent3-rebase-notes.md).

While the pull request is open, another commit lands on main that adds the file agent13-counts-a.md (main's commit 66fbc667db "Add agent13-counts-a.md", visible on /eval/harbor-handbook/commits/branch/main).
Open the pull request's "Files Changed" tab (address above) and read the file list.

bugs.name: Repository settings accept a disabled merge style as 'Default Merge Style'; pull requests then silently use another style
bugs.summary: 'Default Merge Style' always lists all five styles regardless of the ticked 'Merge Styles'. After saving with only 'Create squash commit' enabled and default 'Create merge commit', the settings page keeps and displays the disabled style as the default, and the PR merge box silently falls back to 'Create squash commit' — the stored default is never applied and the settings page misreports it. (on /eval/harbor-handbook/settings (Advanced Settings → Pull Requests))
bugs.expected: The 'Default Merge Style' dropdown should offer only the merge styles enabled in 'Merge Styles' (or the save should refuse/repair a default that is disabled), so the saved default is a style that is actually allowed and the PR merge box uses it.
bugs.actual: 'Default Merge Style' always lists all five styles regardless of the ticked 'Merge Styles'. After saving with only 'Create squash commit' enabled and default 'Create merge commit', the settings page keeps and displays the disabled style as the default, and the PR merge box silently falls back to 'Create squash commit' — the stored default is never applied and the settings page misreports it.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval / momentic-eval-1 and open https://5503-iyhuwnqi1q5k6kqzc08au.e2b.app/eval/harbor-handbook/settings
Scroll to the Advanced Settings panel, section 'Pull Requests' → 'Merge Styles'.

Tick only 'Create squash commit' (untick 'Create merge commit', 'Rebase then fast-forward', 'Rebase then create merge commit', 'Fast-forward only'; 'Manually merged' stays unticked), open 'Default Merge Style' and choose 'Create merge commit', then click 'Update Settings'.
Reload the page and read the same section: only 'Create squash commit' is ticked, but 'Default Merge Style' still shows 'Create merge commit'.
Open https://5503-iyhuwnqi1q5k6kqzc08au.e2b.app/eval/harbor-handbook/pulls/20 (PR 'agent12 settings merge style PR'): the merge button reads 'Create squash commit', not the configured default.

bugs.name: Creating a pull request without permission answers 'Push Failed: The push was rejected. Review the Git Hooks…' although nothing was pushed
bugs.summary: A red toast says \"Push Failed: The push was rejected. Review the Git Hooks for this repository. You must be a collaborator to create pull request.\" The POST to /agent15org/agent15repo/compare/main...agent15-branch-2 answers 400 Bad Request and the console logs a failed resource; the form stays on screen with the title still filled in. Nothing was pushed and no pull request was created, so the \"Push Failed / Git Hooks\" wording describes an action that never happened. (on /agent15org/agent15repo/compare/main...agent15-branch-2)
bugs.expected: Either no create form is offered to a user without write access (the compare page/button should say that alex cannot open a pull request in this repository), or the failure is stated plainly, e.g. "You must be a collaborator to create pull request", without mentioning push or Git hooks.
bugs.actual: A red toast says \"Push Failed: The push was rejected. Review the Git Hooks for this repository. You must be a collaborator to create pull request.\" The POST to /agent15org/agent15repo/compare/main...agent15-branch-2 answers 400 Bad Request and the console logs a failed resource; the form stays on screen with the title still filled in. Nothing was pushed and no pull request was created, so the \"Push Failed / Git Hooks\" wording describes an action that never happened.
reproSteps: Sign out of eval and sign in as alex (alex / momentic-contributor-1), who is not a member of the organization agent15org.
Open https://5503-i6dtbtklp3c8hdj643mx8.e2b.app/agent15org/agent15repo/compare/main...agent15-branch-2 (branch agent15-branch-2 of the public org repo agent15org/agent15repo against main).
Click the "New Pull Request" button to open the create form.
Type "agent15-alex-pr third file" in the Title field and click "Create Pull Request".
